posts.coverText: 3 uncomfortable questions to ask your boyfriend

slideText.text: What's something I do that stresses you out?
Was there anything that made you doubt your trust in me?
Do you feel supported by me?

posts.coverText: 3 questions I want to know but I'm afraid to ask

slideText.text: Do you really mean everything you say to me?
Am I really a part of your life or am I just a passenger?
Would losing me hurt you?

posts.coverText: 4 questions to ask instead of "how was your day"

slideText.text: Tell me, did anything go well at work today?
Did anything make you smile a little more today?
Tell me about something that happened to you today that I don't yet know about?
Is there anything that you feel could have gone better today?
What is something you wish you could tell me but are afraid of how I might react?
What's a small thing I do that you secretly love every time?
What is something you want me to do that I haven't done yet?
What's something I do that always makes you smile?
What do you love most about our relationship?
How do you imagine our life together in 10 years?
What do you appreciate about me?

posts.coverText: 5 questions you should ask your boyfriend

slideText.text: If you could bottle up a moment from our relationship to revisit anytime, what would it be?
What do you think I should know about myself that I am perhaps unaware of?
What about me drew you in when we first met?
What's one thing you think we absolutely must do together in our lifetime?
What's the simplest thing I do that makes you feel loved?
